title: A first season with your own telescope
description: Picking targets that make sense and preparing an observation for the equipment at hand.

blocks.text: After the purchase it is hard for a beginner to tell what they will really be able to see. Beautiful photographs create expectations that have nothing to do with their own experience.

quote.text: Recently bought a telescope and was looking for a free app. Lite is a great version however I was soon hooked and wanted more. For a very reasonable price, I upgraded and have been thrilled with the app. Highly recommend!!

blocks.text: Start from the equipment, the place and the time available. Offer a small set of targets with preparation that makes sense and a log of attempts.
A photograph and visual observation have to be told apart honestly. An evening that did not work is worth going through by conditions, rather than being declared the beginner’s mistake.
